Once upon a time, I worked for this little computer company; back in the day when they couldn't be mentioned in the press without the word "beleaguered" being invoked.

Back in the day Steve Jobs had a weekly meeting with some of the key designers in the operating systems team on the second floor of the 2 Infinite Loop building. I had been included in the meetings a couple of times, knew what they were like, and learned I was happier not being included.

On this particular meeting day, I went to the bathroom in the afternoon and entered a stall to do my business. As I'm sitting there waiting for inspiration to strike, I hear the door to the bathroom open and footsteps enter, two people in animated conversation. I very quickly recognize the voices of The Steve and his "Smithers" (I forget the guy's name, but he was Steve's fawning lackey back then). Smithers was all excited about a demo they had just seen from the Speech team, wherein they could generate "celebrity" voices for speech synthesis. From the safe anonymity of my stall, I listened to the following conversation.

Smithers gushed, "And with all your contacts in the entertainment industry, you could get all kinds of people! Oh! People love British accents! You should get Madonna! And Gwyneth Paltrow!"

I heard the urinal flush, and The Steve responded patronizingly, as only he could, "Madonna. Is not British."

In my head I silently shouted, "For fuck's sake, neither is Gwyneth Paltrow!"

And they exited the bathroom.

Eventually I pooped.
